import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
f=lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P*P+p[3]*(1-np.exp(-p[4]*t))+p[5]*np.sin(p[6]*t+p[7])+p[8]*P*np.exp(-p[9]*t)
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
bestv=(1e9,None)
for trial in range(120):
    p0=np.r_[rng.normal(0,1,5),rng.uniform(0.2,3,1),rng.normal(0,1,1),rng.uniform(0,6.28,1),rng.normal(0,1,1),rng.uniform(0.05,1,1)]
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt,p0)
        v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if v<bestv[0]: bestv=(v,r.x)
    except Exception: pass
print(bestv[0], np.round(bestv[1],4).tolist())
